013/**
014 * IsSeenByPatrols <factionId>
015 */
016public class CaresAboutTransponder extends BaseCommandPlugin {
017        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
018                
019                if (!(dialog.getInteractionTarget() instanceof CampaignFleetAPI)) return false;
020                
021                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = (CampaignFleetAPI) dialog.getInteractionTarget();
022                
023                MemoryAPI mem = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
024                
025                if (mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PATROL_ALLOW_TOFF)) return false;
026                
027                //boolean caresAboutTransponder = Misc.caresAboutPlayerTransponder(fleet);
028                return Misc.flagHasReason(mem, MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_AGGRESSIVE, "tOff");
029        }
030
031}
